data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has loss reserves for various events and for losses that are incurred but not reported (IBNR). Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances. Whilst the syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its recourse for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value. Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the annual accounts for the period in which the adjustments are made.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 59.82m. The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prior-year development figure; instead it notes that loss reserves (including IBNR) continue to develop both positively and negatively and that subsequent information may result in significant adjustments. No quantified gross prior-year release or strengthening is provided in the technical reserves notes, so a net prior-year movement cannot be derived from the disclosed figures.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances.
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the annual accounts for the period in which the adjustments are made.
the ultimate liability will vary as a result of subsequent information and events and this may result in significant adjustments to the amounts provided.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year development (movement in prior years) figure is provided in the notes that can be unambiguously identified. The Profit & Loss line 'Claims incurred - development of prior accident years' is a P&L measure and not the prior-year reserve movement per the instructions, so it was not used. The technical provisions note shows overall changes in claims outstanding but not a breakdown isolating prior-year movements; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. No claims development triangle was presented in the available pages.
